showListing.text: Events FAQ About Contact Sign in Alex Example Don't Be So Hard on Yourself About the Show "Don't Be So Hard on Yourself" is a cabaret concert of new songs written by Alex Example (featuring guest songwriters Jo Marchetti and Teddy Rowe) built around a simple but resonant idea: that we are often our own harshest critics, and that there is real power, and real humor, in learning to sing those harsh words and let them go. Example and a cast of stunning friends each bring their own voice and perspective to the intimate, funny, cathartic material. It's an hour spent in the company of people who are all figuring it out together. Featuring: Cole Bradenton Capri Castellane Jo Marchetti Jamila Sabare Teddy Rowe Genre New Artists Duration 75 minutes Age Restriction All ages 570 Example Avenue New York, NY 10036 View on map Show Disclaimer/Terms All Sales are Final. No Refunds or Transfers. contacts.name: Alex Example
contacts.overrideBody: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw you're bringing an evening of your own new songs to The Example Room on August 3, sung by you and a cast of five. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage, which suits a room that size and material that intimate. I've been a photographer at Carnegie Hall for nearly 10 years. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com/performing-arts. Happy to answer any questions.
